profile.name: Rohith Mogili Golla
profile.title: Marketing Analyst
profile.bio: Experienced Marketing Analyst with 2+ years of experience leveraging data analytics to optimize marketing performance, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across retail and e-commerce environments. Expertise in analyzing large-scale customer and marketing datasets using SQL, Google BigQuery, GA4, Power BI, and Looker Studio to deliver actionable insights, executive dashboards, and predictive analytics. Proven success in marketing attribution, customer segmentation, funnel optimization, cohort analysis, retention analytics, revenue forecasting, and campaign performance measurement. Experienced in automating reporting, building scalable BI solutions, identifying growth opportunities, and partnering with cross-functional teams to improve marketing ROI, customer engagement, and business performance through data driven decision-making.
